dedupe_keys.name: eurostat national supply use and input output tables esa 2010 transmission programme 64 industries and products

description: National supply and use tables and symmetric input-output tables for EU countries, with consolidated tables for the European Union and the euro area. The Eurostat information page says supply and use tables are product-by-industry matrices showing how domestic output and imports are used for intermediate consumption and final uses, and that input-output tables combine them into product-by-product or industry-by-industry matrices. Under the ESA 2010 transmission programme countries send them within 36 months of the reference year: annual supply and use tables (ESA tables 15 and 16) at current and previous year's prices from 2010 and 2015, and every five years use tables at basic prices, tables for domestic output and imports, trade and transport margins, taxes less subsidies, and symmetric input-output tables (table 17). Tables use 64 NACE Rev. 2 activities and 64 CPA 2.1 products, or 88 on a voluntary basis, and follow a standard SDMX template; Eurostat validates the country data. The tables are free in the Eurostat database, with download and API access (formats not stated on the page read). Coverage is EU countries from 2010. Caveats: detailed five-yearly tables lag by three years, and detail varies by country. For simulation they give inter-industry dependencies to model how a sector outage spreads through the economy. Related catalogue records include FIGARO inter-country tables and EXIOBASE.
